title: Histogram
intro: Histogram displays data distribution as vertical bars, with the ability to highlight a selected range. Useful for visualizing data distributions in filter interfaces.
code:

Range: {range[0]} - {range[1]}
Min
setRange([value as number, range[1]]) } />
Max
setRange([range[0], value as number]) } />
) } export default Basic
